_doc: End-to-end data lineage for the openFDA -> Microsoft Fabric analytics pipeline. Every KPI on the report traces back through this chain to the openFDA source, with the governing gate/artifact named at each hop. Grounding proof for Resume A bullet 5.

chain.edge: PySpark quality gate + versioned data contract (coalesce, null/dup/date checks, FAIL->quarantine)

chain.node: Direct Lake semantic model 'openFDA Drug Safety'
chain.edge: Fabric Items API deploy (model.bim inline, no GUI/XMLA)

chain.node: Power BI report 'openFDA Drug Safety Report'
chain.edge: Fabric Items API report deploy (byConnection), bound to dataset c11d0c74

grounding_claim: Every number a human or AI agent reads on the report resolves back through report -> semantic model -> gold mart -> silver fact -> bronze -> openFDA source, with a committed gate artifact at each hop. No number is ungrounded.
